checks.evidence: Default verify: finite, peak_db -3.00, silent_edges -200/-200, dc -56 dB, rebuild, and all three macro claims PASS; no FAIL.

time_shape.evidence: Length 1.054 s (brief 0.4-1.2). Attack: 10-90% rise 3 ms, first sound to 90% peak 3.71 ms, swell/attack 4.2 ms (all under 5 ms). Decay -20 dB 0.24 s, -60 dB 0.84 s, 1 onset at 40 ms merge. Seeds 1-4 are 0.98-1.05 s long with swell attack 3.5-5.0 ms (seed 2 sits right at 5.0 ms and its 10-90% rise is 13 ms).

spectrum.evidence: Body under 150 Hz: energy shares <200 Hz 97%; whole-sound centroid 100 Hz, 106 Hz in first tenth falling to 69 Hz, pitch 69.5 Hz (mode 70 Hz, 0.89 s). 63 Hz band -19.5 dB and 125 Hz -22.8 dB in the first fifth, against 2k -40.5 and 4k -45.5, so the click is 20+ dB under the body and the highs vanish after 0-20% (all bands above 250 Hz at -99.9 from 20% on). Spectrogram shows a bright 31-125 Hz column decaying smoothly to about 0.8 s.

parts.evidence: The latch is visible as short horizontal streaks at about 1.9 / 2.9 / 4.6 kHz and a broadband smear up to about 5 kHz in the first ~50 ms (zoom 0-0.15 s), and the body is a separate 70 Hz mode with 171 Hz overtone. But they start together: fine onsets 0.0 / 50 / 79 / 99 / 107 / 128 ms, one strong event (1.0) and 5 weak, so the click is not a distinct event before the thump. 'Latch click, then body' ordering is not shown; the later fine onsets read as beating of the body (zoom shows ~7 ms ripple), not a second part.

control_variation.evidence: 3 macros (weight, boom, latch_snap), all pass at seed 1: centroid 126->80 Hz, decay 0.17->1.44 s, centroid 86->133 Hz. But verify seeds:4 FAILs seed 4 weight (centroid 102 -> 95 -> 92 -> 79 -> 89 Hz, rises at the top). Seeds do differ (lengths 0.98 / 1.03 / 1.00 / 1.05 s, modes 63-72 Hz, different fine-onset times), all inside the brief. Weight=1 renders 1.62 s, outside the 0.4-1.2 s range (boom=1 decay is 1.44 s too).

notes: The seed-4 weight claim FAIL appears only with verify seeds:4, not in the default verify.

The click and body start at t=0 together, so the latch does not read as 'then'; there is no gap or separate onset.
